content:
Nina Park: Hey team, first day here! I got my MacBook Air M2 and tried to restore from my Time Machine backup. Now Kandji enrollment keeps failing with an "already assigned" error. I'm blocked from finishing setup and can't access Slack on the device. Any guidance?
IT Ops Bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/INC-4999 (assigned to device-team).
Liam O'Connor: Welcome Nina! Can you paste the exact error text Kandji shows and the macOS build?
Nina Park: It says: "Enrollment failed: device serial already assigned to another user (abm_conflict)" macOS 13.6.1 (22G74). Model: MacBookAir10,1. I did a Time Machine restore from my personal Mac (was signed into iCloud there).
Devon Ruiz: Ah that explains it. If the backup brought over an older ABM assignment/profile or the previous machine had the same serial registered in Apple Business Manager, it can conflict. Did you transfer your macOS user account or simply restore files?
Nina Park: I used Migration Assistant and brought apps + settings. I didn't realize that could copy MDM profiles.
Liam O'Connor: Migration Assistant can bring the profiles which confuses the enrollment flow. Two quick fixes: 1) wipe and do a fresh install without restoring profiles, OR 2) have us unassign the duplicate serial in ABM then reassign to you. First option is fastest if you're ok losing local config.
Nina Park: I have a few dev configs I want to keep. Can you unassign on ABM?
Devon Ruiz: Yes, we can. DM me the serial and the device UDID and I'll check ABM. If it's showing assigned to 'Nina-personal' or similar, we'll remove and re-provision.
Nina Park: Serial C02XZ9Q7H123, UDID 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-3a2b-1c0d-9e8f7a6b5c4d. Sent in DM.
IT Ops Bot: People Ops notified for asset reconciliation.
People Ops Bot: Noted. Please confirm this is company hardware supplied today so we mark asset as company-owned.
Nina Park: Confirmed. Company-provided.
Devon Ruiz: I removed the duplicate entry from ABM and re-assigned it to Nina (actioned at 2123456794). I also cleared the stale MDM record on our side. Try rebooting and re-running enrollment.
Nina Park: Rebooting now.
Liam O'Connor: If you still see errors, run these and paste output: 
```
profiles status -type enrollment
sudo jamf recon || echo 'jamf not present'
sudo /usr/libexec/mdmclient dep nag
```
Nina Park: Ran them. Output:
```
$ profiles status -type enrollment
MDM enrollment: No enrolled MDM found
$ sudo /usr/libexec/mdmclient dep nag
MDM: DEP check OK, assigned to org: Redwood Inference
```
Nina Park: Enrollment finished! Kandji is applying device profile and FileVault setup prompt appeared. Also saw a prompt to escrowing recovery key.
Devon Ruiz: Great. We recommend you let FileVault finish escrow. Once Kandji finishes, reconnect to the VPN via company portal and install Homebrew + dev tools. If you need a temp admin for installs, let me know.
Nina Park: Thanks so much. One question: should I avoid Migration Assistant on other corporate devices?
Liam O'Connor: Best practice: use Migration Assistant only when moving between personal devices. For company devices, do a fresh macOS install and copy only documents manually or via cloud storage to avoid bringing previous MDM/profiles. We'll update the new-hire doc with that note.
People Ops Bot: Welcome to Redwood! Orientation calendar invite sent.
Nina Park: Appreciate the quick help everyone :bow:
